info.name: HRMS — Final Full Stack Test Collection
info.description: Consolidated PeopleDesk HRMS collection: original flows plus Phase 3 holiday/calendar, in-app notification, shift, and advanced compensation endpoints. Update local variables before running. Some requests intentionally create or modify records; review each request description and use test-only employee data. Salary credit is simulation only. Collection validation only; run state-changing requests individually with fresh QA IDs and future dates. The payroll sample request exposes bonus and variable_pay. Do not execute the whole collection against existing payroll records.

request.description: Set adminToken from the login response.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('adminToken', body.access_token); pm.test('Admin login succeeded', () => pm.expect(body.access_token).to.be.a('string')); } else { pm.test('Login responded successfully', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200)); }

request.description: Set employeeToken from the login response.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('employeeToken', body.access_token); pm.test('Employee login succeeded', () => pm.expect(body.access_token).to.be.a('string')); } else { pm.test('Login responded successfully', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200)); }

request.description: Simple service status endpoint.
Create only if the email and employee code are not already in use; save response id to employeeId.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('employeeId', String(body.id)); pm.test('Employee created', () => pm.expect(body.id).to.be.a('number')); }

request.description: Use weekdays and choose dates without an overlapping request.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('leaveId', String(body.id)); }

item.name: Leaves · HR/admin adjust annual leave balance

request.description: Use an employee+period combination that does not already exist. Omit base_salary (null) to use the employee profile/effective compensation revision. Bonus and variable_pay can be supplied directly; review other deductions, configured components, overtime and LOP before processing.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('payrollId', String(body.id)); }

request.description: Simulation only—no bank transfer or payment gateway is connected.
Save response as PDF in Postman to capture sample salary slip.
For this request change Body to form-data and add key `file` of type File. Allowed: PDF, PNG, JPEG; max 5 MB.
Use an existing non-admin test user. This route is Admin-only.
This route is Admin-only; avoid disabling the final active Admin.
Confirm the FastAPI process can reach MySQL.

exec: pm.test("Database connection responds successfully", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: Set documentId to a real document ID returned by the document list endpoint. The response is a PDF/PNG/JPEG file.

item.name: Roles · Employee access should be denied

request.description: Expected result is 403 Forbidden when run with Employee token. Do not run this request with adminToken.

exec: pm.test("Employee cannot access Admin user management", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

item.name: 09 · Holiday and calendar management
item.description: Company, regional, optional holiday calendar and selection tests.

request.description: Read-only: lists active holidays applicable to the current user.
Read-only: returns active company, regional and optional holiday calendar items.
Creates an inactive-by-default-to-workday optional holiday record. Does not affect calculations until selected by an employee.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "HRMS QA Optional Holiday {{testRunSuffix}}",
  "holiday_date": "2026-12-24",
  "holiday_type": "optional",
  "region": null,
  "department": null,
  "description": "Postman phase 3 test; optional until selected.",
  "is_active": true
}

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set('testRunSuffix', String(Date.now()));
if (pm.response.code === 201) { pm.collectionVariables.set('optionalHolidayId', String(pm.response.json().id)); }
if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.id !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set('optionalHolidayId', String(body.id)); }
if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.id !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set('holidayId', String(body.id)); }

request.description: State-changing: select the optional holiday stored in optionalHolidayId for the signed-in employee.
State-changing: undo selection for the signed-in employee.
State-changing: soft-deactivates the holiday ID manually stored in holidayId; history remains.

item.name: 10 · In-app notification center
item.description: User-scoped notifications, read state, preferences and manager broadcast tests.

request.description: Read-only: returns notifications for the signed-in employee only, with unread_count.
Read-only: gets notification preferences for the signed-in user.
State-changing: temporarily disables announcement notices for this employee. Restore it to true after testing.
State-changing: restores announcement notifications for the employee.
State-changing: marks notificationId as read only if it belongs to the signed-in user.

item.name: In-app · Mark all my notifications read

request.description: State-changing: marks all current-user notifications as read.
State-changing: creates in-app announcements for active users in the selected department. Review recipient scope before sending.

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set('testRunSuffix', String(Date.now()));

item.name: 11 · Shift and work schedule
item.description: Shift templates, effective-dated assignments and shift attendance reports.

request.description: Read-only: lists active shift templates.
State-changing: creates a unique test shift definition.

  "name": "HRMS QA Shift {{testRunSuffix}}",
  "shift_type": "general",
  "start_time": "09:00:00",
  "end_time": "18:00:00",
  "grace_minutes": 10,
  "break_minutes": 30,
  "overtime_after_minutes": 15,
  "description": "Postman phase 3 test shift.",
  "is_active": true
}

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set('testRunSuffix', String(Date.now()));
if (pm.response.code === 201) { pm.collectionVariables.set('shiftId', String(pm.response.json().id)); }
if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.id !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set('shiftId', String(body.id)); }

item.name: 12 · Advanced compensation
item.description: Salary components and historical compensation revision tests.

request.description: Read-only: shows active and inactive salary components.
State-changing: creates a unique inactive component. It is deliberately inactive so it does not affect payroll until activated.

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set('testRunSuffix', String(Date.now()));
if (pm.response.code === 201) { pm.collectionVariables.set('salaryComponentId', String(pm.response.json().id)); }
if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.id !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set('salaryComponentId', String(body.id)); }

request.description: Read-only: requires testEmployeeId to contain a valid employee ID; omit query string to list all history.
State-changing: requires a test-only employee ID; affects future payroll from 2027-01-01. Run only with reviewer-approved test data.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { pm.collectionVariables.set('compensationRevisionId', String(pm.response.json().id)); }
if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.id !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set('compensationRevisionId', String(body.id)); }
